newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr ends weak on rate/election speculation.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr ends weak on rate/election speculation.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended weaker on Friday at C$1.3970 (US$0.7158) from Thursday's close of C$1.3923 (US$0.7182) unsettled by interest rate jitters and expectations the Canadian government would call an election on Sunday.
* Dealers said the unit slid as speculation resurfaced that the U.S. Federal Reserve could raise interest rates in May.
Traders said investors were also nervous ahead of a federal election call expected on Sunday, Farrill said.
The dollar was hit by Japanese selling overnight, he added.
A currency trader forecast light trading as investors awaited news from this weekend's meeting of G7 finance ministers in Washington.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar strengthened to 1.2354 marks from Thursday's close of 1.2294 and dipped to 90.30 yen from 90.53.
